verdict.rationale: Greptile's core function is AI-generated insights from your codebase. On every PR it posts review comments with suggested code fixes, a 0-5 merge-safety confidence score, findings sorted by severity, generated sequence diagrams and flowcharts, and auto-generated tests. It also offers a synthesized knowledge base per repo and learns from feedback to make suggestions more relevant. A hands-on user reports it catches real issues, and another got a correct, sourced answer, though older HN reports describe indexing failures and incomplete answers on some codebases. Missing for 10: consistent independent corroboration of reliability across codebases, given those earlier failure reports (processing errors, poor template analysis).
